programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA

programme.title: America's Funniest Home Videos

programme.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Black-Eyed, Please: Flanders loses his cool when his laid-back parents start to prefer Homer's company to his own. Lisa is bullied by her new substitute teacher (Tina Fey).

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Dark Knight Court: When Bart's accused of playing a prank on the school marching band - a prank he says he didn't commit - Lisa must step in to defend her brother in court.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Pulpit Friction: A trendy new reverend recruits Homer as a deacon. Dry cleaners accidentally swap Marge's wedding dress for one of Krusty's clown costumes.

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: The Goldbergs

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Hunka Hunka Burns in Love: Homer gets a job writing fortune cookie messages, one of which tells Mr Burns he will find love.
